_comment: Deployment facts for this project, read by morfdeploy. morfSync used to keep its binary in /usr/local/bin and its configuration in /etc/morfsync, alone in the parc. It now follows the same convention as every other service.
_comment_configs: 'migrate_from' lists the earlier homes of this file. The first one found is ADOPTED, not replaced by the example: settings edited by hand outlive the directory convention they were written under. morfSync has been moved once already, from /etc/homeserverhub, and that migration was hard-coded in its install script where nothing else could learn from it.
_comment_status: morfSync now serves /status per morfbeacon/1, alongside the /api/status its synchronisation clients already call. Both are kept: replacing one with the other would break callers to tidy a naming.
_comment_config_dir: La configuration vit sous /etc/morfsystem/<service> : un point d'entree UNIQUE dans /etc pour tout le parc, et non a cote du binaire dans /opt. Effacer /opt/<service> pour reinstaller proprement n'emporte donc pas les reglages.
_comment_state_dir: ETAT PERSISTANT (docs/FILESYSTEM.md) : journaux de synchro par domaine sous /var/lib/morfsystem/morfsync, distinct de la config (/etc, admin) et du programme (/opt). L'unite declare StateDirectory=morfsystem/morfsync : systemd cree ce dossier possede par le user du service, expose via $STATE_DIRECTORY. La cle 'dataDir' du fichier de config permet de surcharger cet emplacement.
_comment_build_dependencies: Bibliotheque necessaire a la COMPILATION : morfSync utilise nlohmann_json (find_package). morfDeploy resout le paquet selon la plateforme (Debian: nlohmann-json3-dev) et verifie avant le build ; sur une toolchain sans gestionnaire, il annonce le besoin.
